title: Neuroprotective effects of ZiYin XiFeng formula against Parkinson's disease via Nrf2/SLC7A11/GPX4-mediated ferroptosis inhibition.
authors: Guo, Xiangyu; Fu, Qiang; Pang, Bowen; He, Huihan; Yang, Ge
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方通过Nrf2/SLC7A11/GPX4通路抑制铁死亡治疗帕金森病，分子对接仅涉及小分子-蛋白，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: ZiYin XiFeng (ZYXF) Formula is a traditional prescription used for the treatment of brain disorders characterized by symptoms such as tremor and dizziness. In recent years, its potential therapeutic effects on Parkinson's disease (PD) have attracted increasing attention. However, the precise molecular mechanisms underlying the effects of ZYXF on PD remain insufficiently elucidated. AIM OF THE STUDY: This study aimed to explore the neuroprotective effects of ZYXF on PD and to elucidate its underlying molecular mechanisms. MATERIALS AND METHODS: In vivo and in vitro PD models were established using MPTP-induced mice and MPP(+)-treated SH-SY5Y cells. Behavioral assessments, histological analyses, biochemical assays, and transmission electron microscopy were employed to evaluate the neuroprotective and anti-ferroptotic effects of ZYXF. In addition, untargeted metabolomics, network pharmacology, and molecular docking were performed to identify potential targets. RESULTS: ZYXF significantly improved motor performance, preserved dopaminergic neurons, and alleviated ferroptosis-associated biochemical and ultrastructural abnormalities. Metabolomics revealed that ZYXF remodeled glutathione and phospholipid metabolism, restoring redox homeostasis. Network pharmacology identified Nrf2 as a key target, and molecular docking further confirmed strong binding affinities between representative ZYXF compounds and Nrf2. Mechanistically, ZYXF activated the Nrf2/SLC7A11/GPX4 pathway, reduced iron overload, and inhibited lipid peroxidation. Its protective effects were mimicked by the Nrf2 activator CDDO-Me and attenuated by the inhibitor ML385. CONCLUSION: ZYXF confers neuroprotection in PD by suppressing ferroptosis through activation of the Nrf2/SLC7A11/GPX4 pathway.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：滋阴息风（ZYXF）方是一种传统方剂，用于治疗以震颤和头晕等症状为特征的脑部疾病。近年来，其对帕金森病（PD）的潜在治疗作用日益受到关注。然而，ZYXF对PD发挥作用的精确分子机制仍未得到充分阐明。研究目的：本研究旨在探讨ZYXF对PD的神经保护作用，并阐明其潜在分子机制。材料与方法：采用MPTP诱导的小鼠和MPP(+)处理的SH-SY5Y细胞建立体内和体外PD模型。通过行为学评估、组织学分析、生化检测和透射电子显微镜评价ZYXF的神经保护和抗铁死亡作用。此外，采用非靶向代谢组学、网络药理学和分子对接以识别潜在靶点。结果：ZYXF显著改善运动表现，保护多巴胺能神经元，并缓解与铁死亡相关的生化和超微结构异常。代谢组学显示，ZYXF重塑了谷胱甘肽和磷脂代谢，恢复氧化还原稳态。网络药理学将Nrf2识别为关键靶点，分子对接进一步证实了代表性ZYXF化合物与Nrf2之间的强结合亲和力。机制上，ZYXF激活Nrf2/SLC7A11/GPX4通路，减少铁过载，并抑制脂质过氧化。其保护作用可被Nrf2激活剂CDDO-Me模拟，并被抑制剂ML385减弱。结论：ZYXF通过激活Nrf2/SLC7A11/GPX4通路抑制铁死亡，从而在PD中发挥神经保护作用。
